svg.title: End-to-end verification: two pods, two nodes, ib_write_bw
svg.text: End-to-end verification: two pods, two nodes, ib_write_bw
Each numbered check proves one layer; stop at the first failure and use the §4 gotcha for that layer
RDMA_Write RC QP: ~390 Gb/s avg at 64 KB+ (97 % of 400G)
STATUS ready; all Applied States ready
uverbs0 rdma_cm; State Active, Rate 400, a LID
Transport IB, two LIDs, ≥ 380 Gb/s at 8 MB
Failure map: ① notReady → §4.4 driver/kernel · ② 0 or Pending → §4.2 selectors/rdmaHcaMax · ⑤ net1 but no uverbs → §4.1 netns · ⑦ hang 'Waiting for client' → §4.3 PKey
